rows.definition: Go constant naming the shared-task patch-result reason ARTIFACT_WITNESS_MISSING: a disaggregated artifact ref was removed without a digest-shaped deletion witness, so the fold quarantines the patch.
rows.distinction: The Go identifier for the wire token ARTIFACT_WITNESS_MISSING; names one missing-witness verdict reason on the shared-task co-editing surface rather than a general witness status.

rows.definition: Wire reason token on a shared-task patch result: an artifact-ref deletion lacked the digest-shaped deletion witness the contract requires, so the write is held as quarantined.
rows.distinction: The serialized wire value carried in patch-result JSON; ReasonArtifactWitness is the Go constant that names it.

rows.definition: Go constant naming the shared-task patch-result reason BODY_WITNESS_MISSING: a disaggregated note-body or task-body ref changed without a digest-shaped deletion witness.
rows.distinction: Body-ref sibling of ReasonArtifactWitness: the same deletion-witness rule applied to note and task body refs instead of artifact refs.

rows.definition: Wire reason token on a shared-task patch result: a body-ref deletion lacked its digest-shaped deletion witness, so the fold holds the patch as quarantined.
rows.distinction: Body-ref counterpart of ARTIFACT_WITNESS_MISSING; ReasonBodyWitness is the Go constant naming it.

rows.definition: Go constant naming the shared-task patch-result reason MISSING_DECISION: a replace of /open_decisions/<id>/state addressed a decision ID not present on the record.
rows.distinction: Names one typed-conflict reason on the shared-task record surface, not a decision log or routing verdict.

rows.definition: Wire reason token in shared-task patch-result JSON: the targeted open-decision ID does not exist on the current record, so the resolution write returns a typed conflict.
rows.distinction: The serialized wire value; ReasonMissingDecision is the Go constant that names it.

rows.definition: Stable identifier field of one open decision row on a shared task record; append id-newness and state resolution are both keyed by it.
rows.distinction: A record field naming one decision instance on the co-editing surface, not a journal entry or a routing decision.

rows.definition: Append-only list field /open_decisions on the shared task record holding unresolved Decision rows; stale appends still merge by decision-ID newness.
rows.distinction: The collection field on the record; DecisionID keys one row inside it.

rows.definition: Store policy field naming the open-decision ID whose approved state unlocks patches the policy holds as APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
rows.distinction: A policy binding to a decision ID, not a field of the decision row itself.

rows.definition: Fold helper applying replace /open_decisions/<decision_id>/state: resolves a decision in place and returns a typed conflict for a missing ID.
rows.distinction: The apply-op helper for decision resolution, distinct from the DecisionID field it dereferences.

rows.definition: Wire conflict reason in shared-task patch results: an append proposed an open decision whose DecisionID already exists on the record (id-newness rule).
rows.distinction: Fires on append of an already-present ID; MISSING_DECISION fires on resolution of an absent ID.

rows.definition: Fold helper parsing an op path of the form /open_decisions/<decision_id>/state into its decision ID.
rows.distinction: The path parser used by replaceDecisionState, not the state-writing operation itself.

rows.definition: Go constant naming the shared-task patch-result reason UNSUPPORTED_PATCH: the op and path combination falls outside the contract's closed patch grammar.
rows.distinction: A per-patch denial reason on the co-editing write-gate, not a feature-maturity score.

rows.definition: Wire reason token in shared-task patch-result JSON: the fold denied a patch whose op or path is outside the supported contract grammar.
rows.distinction: The serialized wire value; ReasonUnsupportedPatch is the Go constant naming it.

rows.definition: Fold helper building the denied patch result carrying UNSUPPORTED_PATCH at the record's current revision.
rows.distinction: The constructor for the unsupported verdict, not the reason token it carries.

rows.definition: Store policy field selecting how the shared-task fold reports a policy-refused patch: deny outright or hold as quarantined.
rows.distinction: Shapes write-side verdicts on the co-editing gate, not an outbound capability or fetch policy.

rows.definition: Reader-scope redaction policy for shared-task views: MaxScope plus IncludeQuarantined decide what View and EventsView reveal to a caller.
rows.distinction: Read-side redaction policy; DenialPolicy shapes write-side verdicts on the same surface.

rows.definition: Fold helper defaulting an empty ViewPolicy scope before redaction so an unset reader scope never widens visibility.
rows.distinction: The normalization helper, not the ViewPolicy type it clamps.

rows.definition: Fold predicate reporting whether an artifact ref points at a disaggregated store, which makes a digest-shaped deletion witness mandatory on removal.
rows.distinction: A shared-task witness-rule predicate, not a commit or process guard; it matches this family only through the substring in disaggregated.

rows.definition: Fold predicate reporting whether a note or task body ref is disaggregated and therefore requires a digest-shaped deletion witness on removal.
rows.distinction: Body-ref sibling of disaggregatedStore under the same witness rule.
